shape: 2-portal perimeter arena (N + E gates) with west wall chain + SW corner cluster
description: Two-portal stage with a perimeter route running around the room. N→E path: spawn_north → vuk49s (NE column) → rnkxj6 (south of N gate) → 1g1ehg → b4kqrq (SW corner 4-way) → a4la5m → 5c7dgi → 2ezl95 → o2yxv3 → spawn_east. The SW corner (b4kqrq) is a 4-way hub joining the west wall + a 2-anchor SW pocket (t69p4c + 2plln2). One east pocket (rvr2lr) hangs off vuk49s.

traversalNotes: STRICT-BACKBONE perimeter: spawn_north → ne_col → n_step → s_step → sw_hub → w_mid → w_up → ne_arc → e_anchor → spawn_east. 9 hops.
